serving: omlx single-process serve on port 8101, 8 fine-tuned fused models symlinked into /Volumes/nvme0/omlx-models (model name = adapter tag); base models unchanged

finetuned.purpose: zero-shot contract outputs of the 8 self-distilled LoRA adapters under the frozen contract, train+calibration+test

adapters.purpose: trained LoRA weights (the primary trained artifacts)
adapters.note: one directory per family__variant; OLMoE-0125 excluded (phase 3 parse failure)

datasets.purpose: self-distillation training data per adapter (base-model native outputs kept as teacher targets)
datasets.note: per-family recipe differences + distinct seeds (llama 7 / gemma 13 / phi4 42 / qwen35 99); see phase4_recipe.json

analysis.losslessness: losslessness.json + losslessness.log (tools/phase4/losslessness.py): (a) exact-match agreement of parsed answers, (b) PPL ratio finetuned/base on 10 calibration articles x 40 items
analysis.consensus: consensus_eval.json + consensus_eval.log (tools/phase4/consensus_eval.py): WCT-EM (3-state MAP-EM Dawid-Skene) vs registered covariate baseline, article-block bootstrap 2000, truth-permutation null 10000, e0, P4/P5/P6

omitted.fused/: 28G of fused full-model weights (8 x ~3.5GB) left on helium; derived = base model + adapter, reconstruct with mlx_lm.fuse
